releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Cinema Hall — a cinema-auditorium Stremio client for the television.

- Cinema mode follows the TV: connect one over HDMI or a wireless display and the show moves onto it and starts the lobby loop; unplug it and the app hands the desk back as a window. A film already playing is never interrupted.
- Films play through mpv when it is installed, so MKV, HEVC, AV1, DTS/TrueHD and ASS subtitles all work, with hardware decoding and HDR. The built-in web player is the fallback.
- Trailers play again: the renderer is served over a loopback http origin, which the embedded YouTube player requires. Trailers that cannot be embedded fall back to the film's artwork instead of a dead frame.
- Self-update from GitHub Releases, applied on quit so a running film is never interrupted. The Windows portable build and unsigned macOS builds cannot self-update and say so in Settings.

Windows: CinemaHall-Setup (installs and self-updates) or CinemaHall-Portable (runs with no install). macOS: the .dmg. Linux: the .AppImage or .deb.
Builds are unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper each want one confirmation on first launch.
